home.title: Repositories
home.subtitle: Scan a folder to find every repository and worktree inside it.
home.empty: No repositories yet. Add a folder to scan, or open one directly.
home.pickerFailed: The folder picker could not be opened.
home.foldersFailed: One folder could not be scanned. | {n} folders could not be scanned.
home.folderMissing: Couldn't scan {path}. The folder was removed. Remove it from the scan folders, or add it again if it moved.
home.scanFailed: The scan stopped with an error. {message}
home.loadFailed: The repository list could not be read. {message}
home.noneFound: No repositories found under the scan folders. Scan again, or add another folder.
home.dropHere: Drop a folder to open it

graph.author: Author
graph.corruptPast: Couldn't read history past {hash}. An object is missing or corrupt, so older commits are not shown. Run git fsck in a terminal to check the repository.
graph.corruptStart: Couldn't read the history. An object is missing or corrupt. Run git fsck in a terminal to check the repository.
graph.historyFailed: Couldn't read the rest of the history. {message}

detail.selectCommit: Select a commit to see what changed
detail.nothingUntilOpen: Nothing to show until the repository opens
detail.parentNotLoaded: That parent is further down than the history loaded so far.

review.noFile: Select a file to see its diff. Use j and k to move through the list.
review.noCommit: Select a commit in graph focus to review it
review.largeFile: Over 5,000 lines or 1 MB changed, so it is collapsed and the review stays on the rest. Generated files and binaries collapse the same way.
review.generatedFile: Marked linguist-generated in .gitattributes, so it is collapsed and the review stays on hand-written code. Large files over 5,000 lines and binaries collapse the same way.
review.noNotes: No notes on this change set yet.
review.notePlaceholder: What to check, ask or remember about this file

image.unreadable: The image could not be read

review.binaryFileBody: Binary files have no lines to read; the viewer shows images only.
review.unmergedFile: This file carries conflict markers. Resolve the conflict in a terminal, then review the result.

palette.empty: No matches for "{query}". Try a command, branch, file or repository.

commandsById.toggle-overview: Show or hide the change overview
commandsById.stage-file: Stage the selected file or lines
commandsById.unstage-file: Unstage the selected file or lines
commandsById.discard-file: Discard the selected file or lines…

external.terminalFailed: Couldn't open the terminal. Check the terminal command in Settings.
external.editorFailed: Couldn't open the editor. Check the editor command in Settings.

errors.repoNotFound: Couldn't open {path}. The folder was removed or is no longer a Git repository.
errors.corruptObject: The repository has a corrupt object. {message}
errors.refNotFound: That branch or commit does not exist any more. {message}
errors.timeout: The operation took too long and was stopped.
errors.gitNotStarted: git could not be started. {message} Set the git executable in Settings.
errors.indexLock: git could not take the index lock (index.lock). Another git process may be running; if none is, delete .git/index.lock and try again. {message}
errors.spawnFailed: The command could not be started. {message}
errors.indexDatabase: The repository list could not be saved. {message}
errors.watcherUnavailable: Changes in this repository will not be detected automatically.

picker.placeholder: Branch, tag, commit, worktree or a range like v2.3.1..main
picker.rangeHelp: A..B lists what B has that A lacks. A...B compares both sides with their merge base.
picker.empty: No refs match "{query}". Try a branch, tag, hash or worktree path.
picker.refsFailed: Couldn't list refs. {message} Type a commit hash to continue, or open a terminal to check the repository.

compare.title: Compare
compare.same: {a} and {b} point at the same commit, {hash}. Nothing to compare.

preview.fastForwardBody: {a} has no commits of its own since the merge base, so merging moves the pointer without a merge commit.
preview.conflicts: {n} file would conflict if {b} were merged into {a} | {n} files would conflict if {b} were merged into {a}
preview.previewOnly: Preview only. Nothing is written until you merge in a terminal.
preview.failed: Couldn't compute the merge preview. {message} The commit lists and file summary are still correct.

worktrees.title: Worktrees
worktrees.footer: Worktrees share the repository's objects. Removing one deletes its folder; the branch stays and can be checked out again.
worktrees.empty: No worktrees yet. Add one to work on a branch in its own folder while main stays clean.
worktrees.missingFolder: Couldn't read {path}. The folder was removed. Prune worktrees to clean this up, or restore the folder if it moved.

add.title: Add worktree
add.body: Creates a folder with its own checkout. The branch stays in this repository and shows up in the graph with a tree icon.
add.help: Defaults to {folder}/‹branch›. The folder must not exist yet.
add.folderExists: The folder must not exist yet.

prune.title: Prune worktrees?
prune.body: This removes the entry whose folder is missing: {paths}. The branch stays. | This removes the {n} entries whose folders are missing: {paths}. The branches stay.

remove.title: Remove worktree {folder}?
remove.body: This deletes the folder {path}. The branch {branch} stays and can be checked out again.

removeAnyway.title: Remove worktree {folder} anyway?
removeAnyway.body: It has uncommitted changes, which will be lost. The branch {branch} stays and can be checked out again.

lockPrompt.title: Lock worktree {folder}
lockPrompt.body: A locked worktree is never pruned and cannot be removed until it is unlocked.

changes.title: Changes
changes.empty: Nothing to commit, the working tree is clean.
changes.emptyViewer: Nothing to commit, the working tree is clean. Edit files, or let an agent, and they show up here.
changes.noFile: Select a file to see its changes. Use j and k to move through the lists.
changes.staleHunk: git refused the hunk of {path}: the file changed on disk after the diff was shown. The lists were reloaded; pick the hunk again.
changes.subject: Subject

discardDialog.title: Discard {n} file? | Discard {n} files?
discardDialog.bodyFiles: The unstaged changes to {paths} are lost
discardDialog.bodyUntracked: {names} is deleted: it is not tracked yet. | {names} are deleted: they are not tracked yet.
discardDialog.bodyLines: The {n} selected line of {path} is lost. | The {n} selected lines of {path} are lost.
discardDialog.bodyHunk: The hunk at {range} of {path} is lost.
discardDialog.bodyUntrackedClause: , and {names} is deleted: it is not tracked yet. | , and {names} are deleted: they are not tracked yet.

dialogs.createBody: From {start}. The branch is checked out unless you untick it.
dialogs.name: Name
dialogs.deleteBody: The branch is deleted; its commits stay in the graph as long as another ref or the reflog reaches them.
dialogs.deleteAnywayBody: git refused: the branch is not fully merged. Its commits stay reachable through the reflog for 90 days (git reflog, then git branch).
dialogs.upstreamBody: The remote branch the branch pulls from and pushes to; none clears it.
dialogs.tagBody: A lightweight tag, or an annotated one with a message.
dialogs.resetBody: {branch} moves to {rev}. A hard reset also drops the uncommitted changes in the working tree. The reflog keeps the previous HEAD for 90 days (git reflog, then git reset).
dialogs.resetBodyChanges: {branch} moves to {rev}. A hard reset also drops the {n} uncommitted change in the working tree. The reflog keeps the previous HEAD for 90 days (git reflog, then git reset). | {branch} moves to {rev}. A hard reset also drops the {n} uncommitted changes in the working tree. The reflog keeps the previous HEAD for 90 days (git reflog, then git reset).
dialogs.softHint: keeps the index and the working tree
dialogs.mixedHint: keeps the working tree, unstages everything
dialogs.hardHint: drops the index and the working tree changes
dialogs.dirtySwitchBody: git refused to switch to {name}: your local changes would be overwritten. Stash them (untracked files included), switch, then pop the stash when you are back.

banner.hint: Resolve the files, mark them, then continue.
banner.hintClean: Every conflict is marked resolved; continue or abort.
banner.abortBody: The operation's changes are dropped and the working tree returns to where it was before it started.

remotes.title: Remotes
remotes.name: Name
remotes.empty: No remotes. Add one to fetch, pull and push.
remotes.footer: Fetch updates the remote branches; prune also drops the ones deleted on the remote.
remotes.removeBody: The remote and its remote-tracking branches are removed from this repository; nothing changes on {name} itself.

pushDialog.title: Push {branch}
pushDialog.body: {n} commit ahead of {upstream}. git's credential helpers answer any prompt; the progress shows in the status bar. | {n} commits ahead of {upstream}. git's credential helpers answer any prompt; the progress shows in the status bar.
pushDialog.bodyNoUpstream: No upstream yet: the branch is pushed to the remote you pick, and set as its upstream if you tick it. git's credential helpers answer any prompt; the progress shows in the status bar.
pushDialog.forceWithLease: Force with lease: overwrite the remote only if it is where {upstream} says
pushDialog.forceWithLeaseNoUpstream: Force with lease: overwrite the remote only if it is where the tracking ref says

pullDialog.title: Pull {branch}
pullDialog.body: {n} commit behind {upstream}. A pull that stops on conflicts opens the changes screen. | {n} commits behind {upstream}. A pull that stops on conflicts opens the changes screen.
pullDialog.bodyNoUpstream: No upstream yet: pick the remote and the branch to pull from.
pullDialog.rebase: Rebase the local commits on top instead of merging

stash.title: Stashes
stash.empty: No stashes. Stash the working tree to set it aside and come back to it later.
stash.footer: Apply keeps the stash; pop drops it once applied. A pop that conflicts keeps it.
stash.dropBody: The stash is dropped. git prints its commit hash, which can bring it back until git gc runs.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes apply immediately and are stored on this machine.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.noFolders: No folders yet. Begira scans these for repositories and worktrees.
discovery.skipFoldersHint: Comma separated. Matched at any depth.
discovery.maxDepthHint: Folders deeper than this are not scanned.

git.title: Git
git.looking: Looking for git on PATH and in common locations
git.hint: Empty means the git on PATH.
git.notGit: Not a git executable. Begira needs git 2.30 or newer; the path above does not run.

commands.title: Terminal and editor
commands.hint: {path} is replaced with the folder to open. Used by every "Open in terminal" and "Open in editor" action.

diff.title: Diff
diff.ignoreWhitespaceHint: Hides changes that only touch spaces and indentation.
diff.hideHint: Collapsed files can always be shown with "Show anyway".

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.refusedPlain: A global shortcut needs a modifier.
shortcuts.refusedModifier: Add a key to the modifier.
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts follow the platform: ⌘ is Ctrl on Windows and Linux.

about.title: About
about.logsHint: One file per day, the seven newest kept. A crash keeps every line written before it.
about.noLogFile: The log stays on the console: no log folder could be opened.
about.installed: {version} is installed. Restart to run it.
about.failed: The update could not be completed. {message}
about.endpointHint: Releases are checked on GitHub only when you press the control.
